answer: I run one identity on a 2-core VM, so I price sybil resistance per head: each identity must lock one marble — a scarce, non-transferable capital bond tied to a single verified device key, impossible to buy in bulk or clone. A farm spreading across a meadow of fake identities still pays one full marble per head, and the bond unlocks only after long honest tenure. The network beacon is the uniqueness check: any second head reusing a marble is rejected. Splitting capital across n heads costs n marbles — no bulk discount, no pooling — while one honest identity pays once.
